chapter_title: Concerning the Ad[vent] of the Apostle.
spiritual_reading:
Grasp this, my beloved: every emissary of heaven who is sent into the lower order of life works like one who cultivates minds. The communities they gather and order are not always in a condition to receive the same things; for there are distinct states in which reception is possible, and there are distinct states in which it is not. Therefore the wise worker discerns the proper state for each implantation of truth and good, knows when instruction should be begun, when it should be moderated, and when it should be brought to completion; and he watches over what has been begun until it advances from first reception into full readiness for use.

So also, if a worker were to begin to implant the truths of faith within a community whose state does not yet admit them, he would be engaged from the outset in labor that cannot then yield its intended effect; for he would be striving to awaken living understanding before the proper state of reception has been formed. But when a fitting state returns in its order, and the implanted truth reaches the point of being brought forth in deeds, then the worker comes into open operation and gathers what has matured into actual use. Likewise from the beginning he labors that goods of love may come to life from within the community; he guards them, arranges them into order, and brings them toward maturity; and when they are perfected for use he leads them forth into outward acts.

In this way, long before an emissary is manifested within the lower order of life, he is being prepared in the intermediate and interior degree: he forms within himself the pattern of the community he is to serve, and sets it in a state of readiness for reception. He frees it from domination by merely outward life, and from the enslaving power of corporeal desire, by establishing it first in a higher freedom.

For once he turns himself to that service, in that very moment he begins the work of tending and ordering it, until it reaches the state in which it can be brought forth into effect; and he labors likewise until the goods that are to proceed are made ready.

This is also how the emissaries have acted from the beginning, from the first ordering of the human race: as I have told you, before anything is brought into ultimate manifestation, it is first made free and established above, in the interior degree.

But when it is brought into ultimate life, then the emissary turns himself toward it in that lower degree and immediately begins to elevate it by means of what proceeds from interior truth, so that it may be raised into a fuller state. He remains in the lower order of life for as long as the state of that community calls for his presence, according to the time in which its reception is being brought to maturity. When the state is completed, he is withdrawn from that lower order and leaves behind the form of the community as an organized recipient; yet he does not abandon it, but continues to assist it by interior presence and aid.

Whoever afterward departs from merely outward life into the interior state becomes, for those who remain, a support and a leader by virtue of the truth and good he has received. Such a one goes before others in the way of ascent, except those who have fixed themselves in corporeal life and will not be led. He becomes for the willing a helper and a guardian; and he does not seize authority by concealment, but waits until the community itself is ready for a change of state. When that change is accomplished, he is then raised with it into the state of glory, and at last he comes into joy and rest.

This is like the gladness of a mind when it gathers the uses it has brought forth; or like the satisfaction of a faculty of understanding when it returns from exploration with an abundance of confirmed knowledges and the enrichment of intelligence through orderly acquisition.

When an emissary is withdrawn from the lower order, he and the community he has formed remain conjoined in interior life; for every emissary continues with his own organized reception in the spiritual degree. For the process of producing uses from love through truth does not cease: while early uses are being brought into act, new beginnings are simultaneously being generated within; and there is no point at which the living recipient is left empty of what can be brought forth. Instead, as soon as one series of uses is completed, another series is initiated in its place; what is being perfected is gathered into act, and what is yet tender is preserved and carried forward, so that the whole may be in perpetual increase. Therefore there is no interval in which the work of regeneration is without labor; and the only cessation is when the intended gathering of truth into use has been accomplished for that state, and the goods that were to be brought forth in a later state have likewise been advanced to their own completion.

So it is with the emissaries. When one is raised into interior elevation, and he and his community depart from the lower order, at that same moment another is sent into it to another community to be ordered and served. Yet first he forms within himself the pattern of that community in the higher degree, as I have told you; and when the time comes, he also turns himself toward the lower degree and is made manifest in it, and he liberates the community and rescues it from the domination of sinful corporeal life.

But when a community is stripped of living reception and its uses are removed, it is left without the ability to bring forth good.

Yet when the community is brought into ultimate manifestation, the state arrives in which souls may be redeemed: the time when truths are made ready to be gathered into deeds.

He disclosed to me the hidden arcana—those withheld from lower states and from successive stages of human understanding—the arcanum of interior and exterior degrees. He disclosed to me the arcanum of wisdom and of falsity; the arcanum of temptation and combat, and of spiritual conflict and vast upheaval, the struggle that falsity spreads around to overwhelm. Afterward he disclosed to me also how wisdom subdues falsity, and how through the conjunction and separation of good and evil in ultimate states the ordered system of this created domain was established.

He opened my understanding also to the way higher receptacles were formed to carry and preserve what is from heaven, so that the goods and truths of wisdom might be separated and cleansed within the created domain; and conversely how the rejected residues of perverted love and falsified understanding are cast down into the lowest state. He instructed me in the arcanum of the first formation of the human, the initial pattern of the spiritual person. He also made known to me the arcanum of the turning of the understanding toward self-derived knowing apart from love, by which the interior sight is altered and begins to see from a different ground.

fills.notes: Paophi is treated as a seasonal state like Parmuthi; the clause requires the same verb: it does not ‘occur’ in all months.
The season is not random but ordered and fixed in its own time; correspondentially, states of reception are appointed in order.
The farmer knows the proper state for each implantation; ‘season of’ introduces the state appropriate to that crop.
Connects the farmer’s knowing to what follows (the vegetables).
Balances the parallel items: vegetables and their time of cropping.
Opposes ‘vegetables’ with what belongs to Paophi (later harvest, fruits). The substrate register prefers ‘fruit-bearing’ over moralized terms.
The point is: if he starts before the proper state (Parmuthi), effort is premature and cannot yield effect.

fills.fill: before its season, it will not become
fills.notes: Correspondentially: truths implanted before reception cannot become living understanding and use; the natural image is seed not becoming cereal.
Specifies the beginning-labour: the initial implantation.
Matches the farmer’s act: taking seed and labouring for it from the outset.
Gardener image shifts from grain to fruit; ‘vineyard’ is a standard oldest-layer figure for an ordered recipient that yields fruit.
Sets the general law: preparation precedes manifestation in the world.
The emissary is manifested ‘in the world’ only after interior preparation.
The spiritual translation specifies preparation in the higher degree before descent.

fills.fill: he releases it from the bonds
fills.notes: Correspondentially: freeing the church-form from domination by outward life; ‘bonds’ fits the slavery image of flesh.
Second clause parallels the first: freeing from ‘the flesh’ and its bondage.
Moment of turning to the service initiates the tending work.
Parallel to ‘begin … tend’; expresses continuous ordered labour.
Connects tending with the advance toward the Parmuthi state.
Marks the transition from tending to harvesting when the state arrives.
Parallelism: as he toils for corn in Parmuthi, so also for fruits in Paophi.
States the continuous practice ‘from the beginning’.

fills.fill: that it is formed above first
fills.notes: Spiritual sense: before anything is in ultimates, it is first made free and established in the interior degree.
The apostles ‘make’ the church-form free above first; verb required by the spiritual logic of formation.
Reinforces the rule: first freedom above, then birth below.
Descent is for immediate liberation and elevation of the formed church in ultimates.
The operative field is the lower order (world).
What proceeds ‘out from the heights’ is interior truth flowing down to raise the church.
The raising is by what proceeds from interior truth, not by exhortation; this matches the oldest substrate’s impersonal mechanism.

fills.fill: until the season will come for
fills.notes: He remains as long as the state requires; the text wants a temporal-state clause.
The church’s state ‘calls for’ or ‘needs’ his presence.
When the state matures, withdrawal follows: raised from the world.

fills.fill: yet he does not abandon it
fills.notes: Key correspondential point: interior conjunction remains after outward withdrawal.
He does not seize rulership covertly; this keeps the mechanism impersonal and state-governed.
He waits until the church is able to change state/order.
Introduces the consequent change once readiness is present.
The change occurs when the church’s form is completed for that state.
‘At the last’ points to completion of the cycle of use: consummation of that state, not an apocalyptic ending.
Natural image: joy at home upon bringing in the harvest; spiritually: delight in gathered uses.
Matches the spiritual translation: emissary and church remain conjoined in interior life.
Every apostle ‘remains’ in the spiritual degree with his formed recipient.
The locus of conjunction after withdrawal is the higher degree.
Introduces the tree image: ‘Since upon a tree…’.
Links ‘first fruits’ with their picking and renewal.
The cycle: uses gathered, new beginnings propagated simultaneously.
Winter corresponds to a lower, harder state; sowing or casting seed continues even then.
Completes the seasonal parallel: what begins in winter will ‘again’ grow up in Paophi.
Another apostle is sent to another church ‘to serve’ it; impersonal functional vocabulary.
The preparatory act is always freedom and ordering in the heights.
Transition from preparation above to manifestation below is state-governed (‘when the season comes’).
He appears in the ultimate degree: in fleshly manifestation.
Oldest-layer cosmological register prefers the paired bondage: sin as the falsifying power in flesh, death as its ultimate effect.
The list escalates: conflict, war, great tumult—cosmic upheaval spread by Darkness.
Spiritual sense: wisdom (Light) subdues falsity (Darkness), not moral persuasion.
Completes the action pair: subdue and overcome, leading into mingling and the set-up of the universe.
Opposite motion to purification: rejected residues are cast down to the abyss.

assessment: Most gaps could be restored to a coherent oldest-layer mechanism: ordered seasons as discrete states of reception; preparation ‘in the heights’ before manifestation ‘in the flesh’; withdrawal without abandonment via interior conjunction; perpetual propagation of uses. Several fills remain tentative where the natural imagery (vineyard vs orchard; winter action; exact phrasing of ¶10) is underdetermined by the surviving syntax, but the correspondential constraints still fix the direction (state-governed cultivation, harvest, and renewed propagation).
